name: @kanzo-tech/graphar
description: An Apache GraphAr graph attached to the host's DuckDB and read as a Graph: its types, properties and their Parquet statistics, a vertex, the edges of a type or at a vertex, search, and patterns across types as SQL, over a view per vertex and edge type; and, for a graph whose document names an RML-Core mapping, the graph read as RDF: its types with their IRIs and labels, and triple patterns as SQL over the views. No engine of its own: everything but `/write` is TypeScript, and `/write` loads graphar-rdf's writer built for wasm32.
